get.summary: Invitations addressed to the caller's verified email that have not expired

Read an invitation with the token from the email, or as the owner of the invited verified address, from a
verified account. A wrong or missing token is `404` whatever the invitation's state. With the right proof, a
closed invitation answers `409` with `INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED`, `INVITATION_DECLINED`, `INVITATION_REVOKED`,
or `INVITATION_EXPIRED`. `can_accept` and `accept_error_code` tell whether this account may accept it

parameters.name: token
parameters.description:
From the email link. Without it, the invitation must be addressed
to the caller's verified email.

environment_variables.description: Names and flags only: a value is never part of an export, secret or not.

project.description: Null for node-level commands such as `DrainNode` and `CleanupRuntime`.

deployment_id.description: Set for `DeployProject`; its output is read through the admin deployment logs endpoint.

error_message.description: The agent's failure message, redacted before it was stored.

duration_seconds.description: From claim to completion or failure, in seconds.

reports_count.description: Events and logs the node reported for a command without a deployment.

reports.description: Present on the command detail only: up to the 200 newest reports, oldest first.

agent_id.description: The ID the agent sends as `X-Agent-Id`.

status.description: The status the node last reported, or `offline` once its heartbeat stopped.

desired_state.description: What the control plane wants: `active`, `draining`, `drained`, or `maintenance`.

agent_version.description: The sakala-agent version from the last heartbeat.

runtime_network.description: The Docker network workloads join on the node, not an IP address.

active_workload_count.description: Projects whose serving deployment runs on this node.

open_commands_count.description: Commands for this node that are Pending, Claimed, or Running.

registered_at.description: When the node record and its token were created.

last_seen_at.description: The last heartbeat; null until the agent first connects.

message.description: Written by the user: show it as text, not HTML.

consent.description: Whether the user agreed to be contacted about it.

generated_at.description: When these numbers were computed. They are cached for up to 60 seconds.

totals.description: All-time counts, not limited by the range.

projects.description: Projects that exist now; deleted projects are not counted.

active_projects.description: Projects with a deployment serving traffic (`active_deployment_id` set).

period.description: Counts for the range. Deployments count by creation time.

new_projects.description: Includes projects created in the range and deleted since.

previous_period.description: The same counts for the window of equal length just before the range, for trend badges.

user_growth.description: New users per WIB day, every day of the range, oldest first.

failure_categories.description: Failed deployments in the range by `DeploymentFailureCategory`, every category, most frequent first.

top_failure_codes.description: The ten most frequent failure codes in the range. `code` is null for failures recorded without one.

new_user_sources.description:
New users in the range by their answer to the onboarding source question. Every `OnboardingSource` is
listed, most frequent first; the last entry, `source: null`, counts users who have not answered.

pilot.description: The pilot validation metrics for the same range, as `GET admin/metrics/pilot-validation` computes them.

activated_users.description: Users who completed onboarding in the range.

unique_deployers.description: Distinct users who requested a deployment in the range.

repeat_deployers.description: Users who requested at least two deployments in the range.

effective_port.description: The `PORT` the next deployment gets: `configured_port`, then `detected_port`, then 3000.

control_requests.description: The newest admin control requests (stop, suspend, unsuspend, reconcile), with the admin's reason.

creator.description: Who created the project; null once that account is deleted.

suspension.description: Reason and time of the suspension in force; null unless `status` is `suspended`.

AdminReasonRequest.description: An admin action whose only input is the reason.

reason.description: Why the admin is doing this. Stored in the audit event.

AdminReasonRequest.title: AdminReasonRequest

owned_teams_count.description: Teams this user owns now, counted against the cap.

effective_max_owned_teams.description: The cap in force: `user.max_owned_teams`, or the configured default when that is null. Admins are not capped.

workspaces.description: Every workspace the user belongs to, the personal one first.

anyOf.description: Limits and usage of the personal workspace; null only for an account without one.

recent_audit_events.description: The 20 newest audit events where this user is the actor or the subject.

onboarding_source.description: The answer to the onboarding question about where they heard of Sakala, or null.

max_owned_teams.description: The per-user cap on owned teams set by an admin, or null for the configured default.

created_projects_count.description: Projects this user created, in any workspace.

members.description: Members, oldest first. `id` is the membership ID.

projects.description: Projects owned by the workspace, newest first. Deleted projects are not listed.

limit_profile.description: The attached limit profile, or null for the default of the workspace type.

personal_user.description: The account a personal workspace belongs to; null for a team.

detail_counts.description:
Sent since agent v0.2.0 so the API can tell when detail arrays
were truncated to 50 items; v0.1.0 omits it. Optional, but
complete when present.

crashed_details.description:
Additive within protocol revision 4: v0.2.0 sends detail_counts
without this key, so it is tied to the list, not to detail_counts.

Optional: agents without crash reporting omit the list, and only
a present list may change runtime state.

path.description:

compatibility_issues.description:

binary sends it; accept both.
